decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module is a dedicated module of the platform's sensor line, the firm invested heavily in developing it, and indoor air monitoring has become more relevant, so continued commitment is warranted.
The firm publicly declared this module the current-generation successor in its hardware roadmap, and a basic voltage measurement module is a core building block that is unlikely to be withdrawn.

The MQTT proxy carries more risk because MQTT support may be folded into newer native bindings, but it is publicly tied to the firm's software-bindings strength and costs little to maintain, so management keeps it.

The CO2 sensor module fits the announced sensor-expansion direction and gained relevance with ventilation monitoring, so any supply difficulties are seen as temporary rather than a reason to withdraw.
The touch panel accessory is a visible part of the firm's ecosystem, and weak sales can still be blamed on temporary component shortages, so management stays committed to it for now.
